title: Cache With Time Limit
summary: TimeLimitedCache with set(key,value,duration), get(key), count(). Keys expire duration ms after their latest set. set returns whether an unexpired value already existed and replaces value and expiry. get returns -1 for absent or expired keys. count includes only unexpired entries. Old timers must not delete newer replacements.
inputFormat: new TimeLimitedCache(); set(key, value, duration) -> boolean; get(key) -> value|-1; count() -> integer
outputFormat: set: boolean (true if an unexpired key existed); get: value or -1; count: unexpired entries
edgeRules: replacement resets expiry from the new set
stale timer must not delete newer value

examples.sequence: set(1,42,50) at 0ms; get(1) at 20ms; count() at 20ms
examples.output: set returns false; get returns 42; count returns 1
